Title: Login succeeds with valid credentials
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter username
2. Enter password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to the products page and the product list is visible

Title: Login fails with an invalid password
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Enter a valid username
2. Enter an invalid password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: An error message 'Invalid username or password' is displayed; The user stays on the login page

Title: Login with an empty username shows a validation error
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Leave the username empty
2. Enter a password
3. Click Login
Expected Result: An error message 'Username is required' is displayed

Title: Adding an item updates the cart badge
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the products page
Steps:
1. Click 'Add to cart' on the Backpack
2. Observe the cart icon

Title: Searching filters the product list
Preconditions: User is logged in and on the products page
Steps:
1. Type 'bike' in the search box
2. Press Enter
Expected Result: Only products whose name contains 'bike' are listed; The result count text is visible

Title: Checkout works
Preconditions: User has items in the cart
